in_marathi.name: Suvajit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suvajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Suvajit is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘su’ meaning good and ‘vajit’ meaning conqueror. It is a name that symbolizes the power and courage of a good ruler or leader.
